articles.title: CCTV Evidence: CCTV Footage Captures Terrorist Attack on CRPF Personnel in Kulgam
articles.description: A CCTV video has emerged showing the terrorist attack on CRPF personnel in Kulgam, Jammu and Kashmir, on November 11, 2026. The footage captures a CRPF jawan on duty when terrorists, who were lying in ambush, suddenly opened indiscriminate fire. As the gunshots rang out, the personnel reacted immediately. One jawan took cover behind a nearby shop, while another retaliated by opening fire at the attackers. After the exchange of gunfire, the terrorists fled the spot. Three CRPF personnel were injured in the attack and were admitted to a hospital in Anantnag for treatment. The condition of Constable Shatish Chandra was reported to be critical, following which he was referred to the Army's 92 Base Hospital in Srinagar. After the attack, security forces and police cordoned off the area and launched a large-scale search operation to trace the fleeing terrorists. Jammu and Kashmir Lieutenant Governor Manoj Sinha visited the 92 Base Hospital in Srinagar, where he met the seriously injured jawan and received an update from doctors about his health.
